fact: The Driver did not follow the Race Director's Instruction for the use of the escape road at the exit of turn 4 (item 18.2 of the Event Notes).
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 44 locked brakes on the approach to turn 4 and went into the run-off area. The Stewards determined that the car was carrying too much speed to enable the driver to use the prescribed escape road and for that reason the driver had a justifiable reason for failing to comply with the Race Director's instruction. Given the circumstances, the Stewards took no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 44 Alleged Failing To Follow Race Directors Instructions
to: The Team Manager, Scuderia Ferrari HP
